# David Machado — Portfolio & Engineering Systems
> Software Engineer & Systems Architect building scalable web applications and distributed architectures.

## Flagship Systems
- Faro: Property Management Platform (ASP.NET Core, React 18, PostgreSQL)
- Zentric Marketplace: Transactional API with DDD and Hexagonal Architecture
- Concurrent Booking Engine: In-memory atomic locking via Redis and optimistic concurrency
- Virtualized Data Explorer: Dynamic DOM windowing and Web Worker multithreading at 60fps
